name: infra/Nomad API unauth jobs list
description: [medium] HashiCorp Nomad HTTP API (4646) answers /v1/jobs without auth (CWE-306): the job table = workload layout, task-group names, datacenter spread; job specs often embed secrets. Nomad stamps X-Nomad-Index headers on API answers — used as the fingerprint so even an empty [] list proves the surface. Keywords: nomad 4646 jobs unauth api x-nomad-index hcl discovery. ctrl: ACL-hardened Nomad answers 403 without Nomad headers -> not falsified. base_url = http://<nomad>:4646.
